summary.en: CHOP spreads the pieces over the pads.

topic: turning one sample into many pads

verifiedAgainst.title: SP-404MK2 Reference Manual — Using a marker to split and assign a sample to a pad (CHOP)

text.ru: [VALUE] → ASSIGN TO PAD → [VALUE]. Пустые пэды мигают жёлтым.
text.en: [VALUE] → ASSIGN TO PAD → [VALUE]. Empty pads blink yellow.

text.ru: Выбери пэды [1]–[16], [VALUE] расставляет куски по порядку, [MARK] подтверждает; финальное нажатие [VALUE] записывает.
text.en: Pick pads [1]–[16], [VALUE] orders the pieces, [MARK] confirms; the last [VALUE] press writes them.

tryIt.en: Split a four-bar loop into eight pieces.
